an9.31:1.1: “Monks, there are these nine step-by-step cessations.
an9.31:1.3: “When one has attained the first jhāna, the perception of sensuality has ceased.
an9.31:1.4: When one has attained the second jhāna, directed thoughts & evaluations [verbal fabrications] have ceased.
an9.31:1.5: When one has attained the third jhāna, rapture has ceased.
an9.31:1.6: When one has attained the fourth jhāna, in-and-out breaths [bodily fabrications] have ceased.
an9.31:1.7: When one has attained the dimension of the infinitude of space, the perception of forms has ceased.
an9.31:1.8: When one has attained the dimension of the infinitude of consciousness, the perception of the dimension of the infinitude of space has ceased.
an9.31:1.9: When one has attained the dimension of nothingness, the perception of the dimension of the infinitude of consciousness has ceased.
an9.31:1.10: When one has attained the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception, the perception of the dimension of nothingness has ceased.
an9.31:1.11: When one has attained the cessation of perception & feeling, perceptions & feelings [mental fabrications] have ceased.
